expects.reason: This branch is SDK-style with PackageReference under Central Package Management, so `dotnet list package --vulnerable` applies. It needs a restore and live advisory data from NuGet, which this host's egress proxy refuses. Where NuGet is reachable it runs and reports the planted pins.

data.planted: the reference-graph guard: all five planted pins named from compiled code
data.expected: five vulnerable packages, read from the branch's own root manifest
data.note: The C# core of this folder's fixtures is C# 5-compatible, so it is identical on all 13 families and what the tool measures cannot drift between them. The LanguageMarker class in each file is what pins the file to C# 12.0; it does not compile under C# 11.0. No project manifest is present, by design.
